From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Prorata credit addendum & term alignment for FY26 renewal

Alex —

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, ClarityTech is planning a term reset at renewal (moving from calendar-year to fiscal-year billing) and wants the coverage schedule to reflect the Q3 capacity ramp. That change creates a partial-period overlap for which procurement asked for a pro‑rata credit mechanism instead of a one-off manual adjustment.

Attached is a draft addendum that: 1) shortens the existing MSA term to align with your FY window, 2) adds a pro‑rata credit line in Section 3(b) tied to invoiced token usage during the overlap period, and 3) includes a one‑time coverage schedule reconciliation worksheet (Coverage_Schedule_ProRata.xlsx).

Can you confirm the following by EOD Tuesday so we can route to legal for a quick markup?
- Is ClarityTech comfortable with the proposed credit being calculated against net token spend (post discounts)?
- Do you need the credit to be refundable or applied as a forward-facing invoice credit?
- Any internal signers beyond Procurement (we assume VP Ops and Procurement lead).

We've flagged two limited legal asks for quick review: a tight definition for "Overlap Period" and wording around timing for credit calculation (30 vs 45 days). Ben and Laura are on copy to coordinate legal edits.

Attachments: ClarityTech-Addendum_v2.docx (docx, 38KB); Coverage_Schedule_ProRata.xlsx (xlsx, 14KB)

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Alex Nguyen <alex.nguyen@claritytech.com>

Cc: Cathy Zhao <cathy.zhao@claritytech.com>, procurement@claritytech.com, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 13:47:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Prorata credit addendum & term alignment for FY26 renewal

Marissa —

Thanks for sending the draft. Quick answers before we loop legal:
- We prefer the credit to be calculated against net token spend (post-discounts). That matches our internal finance reporting.
- We would like the credit to appear as a refundable credit on the next invoice cycle (so Finance can reconcile it directly). If refunds require extra paperwork on your side, an applied forward credit is acceptable, but refundable is preferred.
- Primary signers: Procurement (copied), VP Ops (Cathy Zhao), and CFO sign-off (I will confirm if CFO is required but expect yes).

A few clarifying questions on the draft:
1) "Overlap Period": can you confirm it's limited to the exact calendar dates used for our transition window (Sept 1 — Nov 30), not by invoice date?
2) Timing for credit calculation: we prefer 45 days to give our chargeback team time to validate usage.
3) On Section 4, there is a reference to a "coverage reconciliation" that looks like an internal Redwood template — can you attach the populated version for ClarityTech so we can validate numbers?

If you can send an updated version with those two changes, we can route internally and aim to return comments within 48 hours.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

—Alex
Alex Nguyen
Head of Platform Integrations | ClarityTech
alex.nguyen@claritytech.com | +1 (212) 555-3321

Marissa / Laura —

Looping legal ops notes inline. I also attached a clean markup suggestion (ClarityTech-Addendum_v2_BenMarkup.docx) for quick insertion. Key suggestions:

- Overlap Period definition: tie to fixed calendar dates ("September 1, 2026 00:00 UTC" through "November 30, 2026 23:59 UTC") and add a catch-all if the parties mutually agree to a revised window in writing.
- Credit calculation: use "Net Token Spend" (minus any promotional credits) and require Finance validation within 45 days. If ClarityTech insists on refundable cash, add a short clause for refund processing (30‑45 days after validation) and cap at the invoiced amount for the period.
- Warranty/indemnity language: keep existing MSA clauses; do not add new indemnities tied to the credit.

Proposed language (extract):
"Upon expiration of the Overlap Period, Redwood shall calculate the Net Token Spend for the Overlap Period. Within forty-five (45) days following the end of the Overlap Period, Redwood shall issue a credit equal to the amount calculated pursuant to this Section 3(b), which shall be either: (i) applied to the next invoice issued to Customer, or (ii) refunded as mutually agreed in writing and subject to Redwood's refund processing terms."

I recommend we push the 45 days language (Alex wants 45) and confirm refundable vs applied credit via procurement. If procurement wants refundable cash, legal may ask for a short escalation path for chargebacks.

Attachments: ClarityTech-Addendum_v2_BenMarkup.docx (docx, 42KB)

-Ben
